The MVP accounting model uses a tenant-scoped Chart of Accounts, Journal Entry + Journal Line double-entry structure, ledger views, Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet and reconciliation. Posted accounting records are immutable.

Live IRN and e-way bill generation is in M1. The exact production provider, authentication model, payload mapping, retry rules and government-service error mapping belong in the E-Invoice / E-Way Bill Integration Specification and API contract. The FRD therefore defines the business trigger and outcome, not an invented external API contract.
Payroll is basic only in M1. Statutory PF, ESI and TDS computation/filing are explicitly excluded.
Reports are derived views over authoritative transaction, inventory and accounting data. The visualization dashboard remains an open scope decision; basic reports remain in M1.
Offline capability is intentionally constrained. Not every module is offline-writable.
